verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI's own model docs list keyterms prompting of up to 1,000 words plus contextual prompting, which directly boosts domain terms, names, and jargon. Community users describe the product as customizable to medical vocabulary and terms of art; one critic doubts how well new words work without LM data, but that is skepticism, not a concrete failure. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of keyterm usage and limits (streaming vs. async support, how boosting behaves), and recent hands-on accuracy corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can boost domain terms, names, and jargon through custom vocabulary or keyword boosting so they transcribe correctly

citations.quote: AssemblyAI is customizable to a medical vocabulary, which Google isn't.
